description: This file defines the MyClaimRequestAPI class, which manages API endpoints related to employee claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, and listing claim requests, along with validation rules and integration with models and external components.

classes.name: MyClaimRequestAPI
classes.description: API class handling employee claim request operations such as creation, retrieval, and listing claims, extending base ClaimRequestAPI functionality with additional validation and filtering logic.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new claim request by delegating to the parent implementation.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks if the current user is the employee with the provided employee number; always returns true in this implementation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a claim request.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific claim request by ID, delegating to parent implementation.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single claim request.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all claim requests for the authenticated user, delegating to parent implementation.

methods.name: getClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Provides default search filter parameters for claim requests.

methods.name: getEndPointCollectionResult
methods.description: Returns a formatted collection result based on the claim requests and model type.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the employee numbers filter based on the logged-in user for claim requests listing.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing claim requests with sorting and pagination options.
